clauses.text: Configure one US inbound lead routing workflow. Every qualifying lead must be assigned to an active representative.
Deliver one sales dashboard with two revision rounds. One round remains unused.
Provide a four-hour administrator training session. This deliverable has not started and has no downstream dependencies.
Additional countries and regional routing rules are excluded. Any paid addition or deliverable substitution requires consultant authorization and client acceptance.
Correct failures against agreed acceptance criteria without an additional fee.

correspondence.text: The current project covers the US workflow. We can discuss other regions separately once you know the requirements.

requests.text: Qualifying US leads are being assigned to an inactive rep. Please fix the routing.
